advisories: /tmp/dps-inhibit-review-combined.tex: 3 frame(s) exceed the source-density guide; review at projector size
visual_review: All 22 pages inspected from 1400-pixel renders: individual views of the architecture, path method, BDE cooling, rack diagram and new tables; contact sheets for the other pages. Slide 18 re-rendered and inspected after the final wording change. No visible overlap or clipping.
advisory_review: Source-density advisories affect slides [4, 8, 9]. Their TikZ source contributes to the count; rendered diagrams were inspected individually.
content_review: Original DPS/SC/BMS/local-interlock definitions and four input domains retained; detector now includes rack infrastructure.
One consistent detector overview includes SC OPC UA, shared PDU/WIENER SNMP control/status and BDE/bias EtherCAT plus wired PL506/ISEG inhibits.
Slide 7 traces source, input, decision, output/load and feedback; records physical connections and allowed detection-to-shutdown time; shared I/O counted once.
Slide 8 uses the documented fan-status / EL1004 / PLC / EL2124 / PL506 path. Six-fan arithmetic is conditional baseline coverage, not a new-module count.
Slide 9 separates rack/PDU/sensors from subsystem supplies and dedicated inhibits. Humidity monitoring does not imply a shutdown rule.
Detector additions use 34 PDS LV feeds, 80 PoF boxes, Opta/Beckhoff alternatives, TDE PDU-only current control with future interfaces retained, and existing CalCI material.
FFDG uses API through Batavia and SC; availability of each required alarm remains to be mapped. SDSTA remains under investigation.
VD rack space and first-pass bias output capacity are distinct from proven spare terminals. Fan-only component load replaces the earlier linear HD-to-VD panel-power extrapolation.
Prototype tests and hardware/procurement readiness lead to June 2027 review; full VD response-matrix review remains early 2028.
limits: Presentation/source/arithmetic review only; no new installed-wiring, controller or response-time qualification.
The inhibit review remains underway. No complete new-I/O count or approved additions bill of materials is claimed.
Pinned local sources; no fresh EDMS latest-version check. CUC location and work assignments remain proposals.
